buttons.chatHome: 📱 Open the chat in the app

chat.welcome:
👋 Hi! I keep track of home poker games: buy-ins, rebuys, cash-outs and settlement.

To start, send /newgame and I will post a game message with buttons. Cash-outs, custom amounts and actions for others are in the app (the “📱 Open” button).

Make me an admin allowed to pin messages so that the game message gets pinned.
chat.pinFailed: I could not pin the game message. Please make me an admin allowed to pin messages.

commands.activeGameExists: “{{name}}” is already in progress in this chat. Finish it first.
commands.noActiveGame: No active games. Start one with /newgame.
commands.historyText: The chat's game history is in the app.
commands.settingsText: Chat settings are in the app.
commands.stats: Statistics are coming in the next version.
commands.groupOnly: Games are created in groups: add me to a chat with your friends and send /newgame there.
commands.anonymous: Please send the command as yourself, not anonymously, so I can check that you are a member of the chat.
commands.notMember: Only members of the chat can create games.
commands.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
commands.welcomePrivate:
Hi! I keep track of home poker games in group chats. Add me to a group and send /newgame there.

The app has your profile, language, payment details and your chats.
commands.helpGroup:
Commands:
/newgame [name] — new game
/game — current game
/history — game history
/settings — chat settings
/help — help

Buttons under the game message:
✋ I'm in — buy in for 1 stack
➕ Rebuy — rebuy for 1 stack
↩️ Undo mine — undo your last action (up to 15 minutes)
📱 Open — cash-outs, custom amounts, guests and finishing the game
commands.helpPrivate:
I keep track of home poker games in group chats. Add me to a group and send /newgame there; /help in the group shows the details.

/start — open the app: profile, language, payment details and your chats.
